source: Editorial task: explain a school roof inspection report to parents. Damp patches were recorded in three classrooms. The inspector suggests checking the roof as one possible source; plumbing is another possibility. No cause is confirmed. The school has arranged inspections, not repairs.

idea.title: Why the school is checking possible sources of damp
idea.description: Explain the observations and planned inspections without choosing a confirmed cause.
idea.rationale: The roof is a possible source that warrants checking alongside plumbing.
idea.evidence: Three rooms have damp; roof and plumbing are possibilities.
